authority.section: PUBLICATION REPRODUCIBILITY STANDARD — V2 AND ALL FUTURE PAPERS

requirements.evidence: V1 exposes hashes, verifiers and rerun components, but not two prominent unified commands.
requirements.improvement: Ship distinct network-minimal verify and full isolated reproduce entry points.

requirements.evidence: V1 identifies important runtimes and models but lacks one complete machine-readable execution environment manifest.
requirements.improvement: Bind OS, architecture, hardware, runtime, database, extensions, dependencies, concurrency, models and timestamps.

requirements.evidence: Restricted benchmark text is downloader-and-hash based with pinned upstream identities.
requirements.improvement: Retain exact revision, license, file and SHA-256 coverage in V2.

requirements.evidence: Publication aggregates and exporters generate the reported V1 numerical tables.
requirements.improvement: Make every V2 numeric cell map to one script, field, run and hash.

requirements.evidence: V1 Appendix A maps central claims to code and required evidence.
requirements.improvement: Extend the V2 map to every quantitative and security claim, denominator and limitation.

requirements.evidence: Intended-N and run status exist, but complete per-attempt evidence is partly private and no single sanitized public ledger exists.
requirements.improvement: Release a bounded machine-readable attempt ledger covering failures, retries, exclusions, reuse and terminal status.

requirements.evidence: V1 explains withheld datasets and identity-bearing evidence in prose.
requirements.improvement: Release one machine-readable manifest naming every withheld artifact and reason.

requirements.evidence: The clean public source tree passed release gates, but the complete experiment was not rerun through one public fresh-machine command.
requirements.improvement: Run verify and reproduce from a clean checkout across supported runtimes and retain the environment-bound result.

requirements.evidence: V1 binds source and evidence hashes but lacks one complete TeX/PDF/package/license/DOI archival record.
requirements.improvement: Bind source, evidence, TeX, PDF, package, licenses and DOI into one immutable record.

requirements.evidence: A V1-to-V2 claim, protocol, model, dataset, artifact and result ledger did not exist at V1 release.
requirements.improvement: Generate and verify the exact change ledger before V2 publication.
